name: Conversations With My Anxiety
source:
Conversations With My Anxiety is a short narrative game about self doubt & first date jitters. Throughout the night, our player recedes into his mind, confronting his anxiety. Depending on how you handle fears and doubts, the date can play out in a variety of different ways.

[from [url=https://digitaldaydream.itch.io/conversations-with-my-anxiety]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Conversations With My Anxiety》是一款关于自我怀疑与初次约会紧张感的短篇叙事游戏。整个夜晚，主角不断退回自己的内心，与焦虑对峙。根据你应对恐惧与疑虑的方式，这场约会将走向不同的结果。

[摘自[url=https://digitaldaydream.itch.io/conversations-with-my-anxiety]itch.io[/url]]
